system.description:
Requirements: You must have at least one tempered ur-stone worn against your skin

Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Self

You create a shield of Jade energy to knock away an attack before it can strike you.

When an attack would hit you, you may spend 1 Resolve to negate the attack.

You must choose to use this ability before any other effects from the attack are applied.

If you use this ability against an adjacent creature, your Melee increases by +1 against that creature until the end of your next turn.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.YjlnhbXi1GGV4qzw]{Jade Deflection}
